subject: Coordinating multi-prospect demo: bridge slot map + staggered reminders
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@atlasfin.tech>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@meridianhealth.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coordinating a joint demo with AtlasFintech + Meridian Health — proposed plan

Hi Emily and Raj —

Thanks again for the interest in a joint technical walkthrough. Because both teams asked for a hands-on component and we want to avoid two separate bridge links, I propose a single 75-minute session with staggered arrival windows and breakout flows:

- 0–10 min: intro + goals (all attendees)
- 10–35 min: demo + live prompts (all attendees)
- 35–55 min: breakout A (AtlasFintech) / breakout B (Meridian) for tailored prompts and questions
- 55–75 min: reconvene + next steps

To keep latency expectations correct, we plan two hosts: Ben will run the AtlasFintech breakout and Laura will cover Meridian’s use cases. I can moderate the full session and own the shared demo environment.

Please reply with your preferred window (all slots in PDT):
- Tue Aug 3, 10:00–11:15 (preferred)
- Wed Aug 4, 16:00–17:15 (alternative, allows APAC participants)
- Thu Aug 5, 08:00–09:15 (early slot)

I attached a draft agenda and an attendee roster stub so you can verify participants. Also included bridge instructions (dial-in + recording policy).

Quick ask for internal folks: Ben/Laura, if you can confirm host + a 10-minute pre-call to stage the KV cache and any quantization fallback we should use for the live runs, that would be great.

Thanks —
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai

Attachments: 2027-07-28-demo-agenda.pdf; attendee-roster-AtlasFintech-Meridian.csv; bridge-instructions.txt

Sergio —

All good from me. I can host the AtlasFintech breakout and take the lead on the live prompt set focused on fraud-detection and transaction-parsing. I’ll be available for a 10-minute staging call at 9:15 PDT on Aug 3 (if we go with that slot).

Two quick notes:
- For AtlasFintech’s samples I’ll preload a short prompt set and a small user history so the KV cache is realistic.
- If the group prefers recording off for privacy, we should call that out in the calendar invite.

Confirmed preference: Tue Aug 3, 10:00–11:15 PDT.

Thanks — Aug 3 works for AtlasFintech. A couple of items from our side:

- We’ll have 6 engineers and 2 PMs joining (list in attached roster).
- Preferred: recording is on but we’ll ask participants not to paste PII during the live demo.
- Can you confirm whether the breakouts are separate bridge links or in-channel rooms? We prefer separate breakout rooms so we can keep specific logs separated.

If separate rooms are easiest, can you provide links ahead of time and a short runbook for how we re-join the main room?

Emily

Emily —

Thanks, appreciate the headcount. We’ll do separate breakout links (one per prospect) and provide a short runbook in the calendar invite. Recording: we’ll keep the main room recorded and disable recordings for the breakout rooms to respect isolation.

Laura/Ben — could one of you create the two breakout links and post them here? Also: I want a staggered reminder cadence so that AtlasFintech gets a 15-minute pre-reminder with a short note about the preloaded prompts, and Meridian gets a 30-minute reminder (their team prefers a longer window). Proposed reminder schedule (relative to start):
- AtlasFintech: 15 minutes before — note about preloaded prompts + ask to mute mics until the intro
- Meridian: 30 minutes before — reminder + link to join breakout B if you arrive early

If you’re okay I’ll also include a quick DR plan in the invite: fallback model variant + fallback bridge region.

Sergio
